s.nota: From Cossogno amidst chestnut on the ancient cobbled mule track to Alpe Rugno, then for the meadows of high pastures and finally the long panoramic ridge that culminates at Pizzo Pernice

s.n: P01 - Madonna di campagna - Monterosso - Cavandone
s.nota: An easy walk on Monterosso, mountain overlooking Verbania. Roads and firebreaks facilitate the journey. A picnic area with views of Stresa and the Borromeo Gulf is a pleasant stopover to climb term
A long walk in the woods and the hills between Lake Maggiore and Mergozzo on the historic Roman road that led to the Ossola and the Simplon Pass

s.n: P00 - Madonna di Campagna - Santino - Rovegro- Cossogno- Cicogna - Pogallo
P00c - Nord Monterosso - Bieno - Oratorio Santino
s.nota: Useful way to link the path P00 between the north Monterosso area and the Oratory of Santino, Bieno through, without to loose elevation down to Santino

s.n: P01a - raccordo tra P01 e P00
s.nota: Short path along the hillside on the forested northern side of Monterosso that connects the path P01 with the path P00

From Fondotoce locality Canton Magistris, which also leads to the "Special Nature Reserve" of Fondotoce on Lake Maggiore, you go up along a paved mule track between chestnut groves in Cavandone sul Monterosso

s.n: A00g - Fondotoce scalinata cimitero vecchio - bivio A00e
s.nota: From Fondotoce along the steep staircase of the old cemetery and then on the track and then the path You reach the paved mule-track that goes up to Cavandone
Very steep path that from Suna climbs to the Chiesetta del Pellegrino, historically followed by a Christian worship procession very popular among the Suna population
Mountain side path on the Monterosso that from Suna climbs to Cavandone among chestnut woods and with views over the Borromeo Gulf

s.n: P01d - Cavandone - bivio Via al Monterosso
s.nota: An easy walk almost flat in the woods of Monterosso. Pay attention to mountain bikes

The Filo di Nolezzo is worthy of its name: a perfect ridge line, aerial from beginning to end, extremely panoramic and never really difficult, even if there are some very exposed and treacherous sections, especially in autumn for the leaves

s.n: R02 Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca - Arizzano - Albagnano - Premeno - Pizzo d'Omo
s.da: Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca (m 210)
s.nota: From Verbania Intra crossroads R30 Via Selasca through Pastura, Antoliva, Cresseglio, Cissano, Arizzano, Albagnano, then the holiday resorts Premeno and Pian di Sole, to climb to Pizzo d'Omo (m 1056) and finish at the crossroads of the path R02,R02A,R10.

s.n: R04 Verbania Intra - Zoverallo - San Martino - Bèe - Monte Cimolo - Pian Nava
s.da: Verbania Intra P.za Ranzoni, bivio R30 (m 200)
s.nota: From Verbania Intra P.za Ranzoni (crossroads R30) through Zoverallo, San Martino, Bèe, to climb to Monte Cimolo (m 950) and walk down at Pian Nava (crossroads R06, R08).

s.n: R00 Verbania Intra P.le Flaim - Trobaso - Cambiasca - Caprezzo - Intragna - Aurano
s.nota: From Verbania Intra P.le Flaim through Trobaso,Cambiasca,Caprezzo,Intragna to Aurano, crossroad with R8,R14,R15. Long path that enters the uncontaminated Valle Intrasca of the San Giovanni torrent, adjoining the Val Grande National Park.

s.n: R01 Verbania Trobaso - Unchio - Motto di Unchio - Pian di Les - Cossogno
s.da: Trobaso, bivio R00 Via al Cotonificio (m 240)
s.a: Cossogno, bivio P00 Via San Martino (m 365)
s.nota: From Verbania Trobaso, Via al Cotonificio, you reach the cycle road on the left side of the San Bernardino river, go up to Unchio and the Oratory of Motto di Unchio, then through a peat bog and Pian di Les, you reach Cossogno (crossroads P00).

s.a: Nord Pizzo d'Omo bivio percorso R10 (m 920)
s.nota: From Premeno,crossroad R02,in direction of Le Australie,go up the provincial road to Pollino,after about 300 m deviate into V.Manegra. A path on the left leads to Sasso Mezzano with a wonderful view of Lago Maggiore,then to the crossroad with R10.

s.n: R10 Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino - Piancavallo - Colle - Passo Folungo
s.da: Sacro Monte SS. Trinità di Ghiffa, bivio R30 (m 392)
s.a: Passo Folungo, bivio R11, R19, R20, S15 (m 1369)
s.nota: Long route from the Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa,Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage,to Passo Folungo,between Valle Intrasca and Cannobina,through Caronio,Pollino,Luera,Manegra, Piancavallo,crossroads for Cima Morissolo,Colle,Pian d'Arla and Pian Puzz.
The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

s.n: R03 Cambiasca - Pian Cavallone - Pizzo Marona - Monte Zeda
s.nota: Route of great landscape interest that goes from Cambiasca to Monte Zeda passing from the peak of Pizzo Marona; it crosses Miazzina,Alpe Pala,Cappella Fina,Pian Cavallone,Colle Forcola,Passo del Diavolo,Pizzo Marona. Exposed stretch with chains.

s.n: R07 Intragna - Cappella del Pian Cavallone
s.a: Cappella del Pian Cavallone - bivio R03 (m 1544)
s.nota: In very open environment between Intragna and the Rifugio Pian Cavallone CAI Verbano,through Cambiesso and Sunfaì along the route of the Valle Intrasca Marathon.Continuing on R03,near the ruined of ex-hotel,there is the winter bivouac always open.

s.n: R05 Caprezzo - Pian Cavallone bivio R07
s.nota: The route connects Caprezzo to the R07 crossroads just below the CAI refuge at Pian Cavallone. From Caprezzo, climbing to the Mon Rous and Ad Vel pastures, you reach Cappella Porta, then, in a beech and fir wood, climb to the CAI Verbano refuge.

s.n: R03a Cappella Fina bivio R03 - Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala
s.a: Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala (m 1200)
s.nota: Connection route between Cappella Fina (crossroads R03) and crossroads with R05 Cappella Porta-Cornala. Useful for the R03-R05 ring route through Pian Cavallone. Some large part of the route on a wide dirt road and part on path. Some small stream fords.

s.n: R30 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannero - Oggebbio - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Verbania Intra
s.nota: Historic "Via delle Genti". Route from Cannero to Intra through the numerous hamlets of Oggebbio. Superb panoramic view of Lake Maggiore in a succession of frescoed oratories and chapels. Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage.

The route starts from Aurano, descends to the stream of Val Luisina crossing the provincial road several times; it climbs to Esio with a path immersed in broadleaf forest and first on the road and then on a comfortable mule track comes to Premeno.
The route, in the woods on the hillside, starts from the square of Esio on a paved road, then continues on a gravel road and on a path, then on a cart track it reach Luera.

s.n: P01v - Sentiero della Bergamina variante turistica
s.nota: Variant to route P01c which avoids on the road an uncomfortable stretch of the path

s.n: R01a - Bivio R01 Cappella Madonna di Re - Bivio P00 in piazza a Santino
s.da: Bivio R01 C.la Madonna di Re
s.a: Bivio P00 in piazza a Santino

s.nota: Short connection between the R03 and P02 paths and the quickest access to the large summer pasture of Runchio (Rugno)

s.n: P02c - Memoriale Alpini - Alpe della Chiesa
s.a: bivio P02 sopra Alpe della Chiesa
s.nota: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route

s.n: P02d - Cappella Fina - bivio P02 sotto Monte Todun
s.nota: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route

Initially you travel along roads and dirt roads till Romanico then you enter broad-leaved woods up to the destination with a route mainly on paths and forest tracks. A ford at the Selva Spessa stream can pose problems in case of rain

s.n: R01b Bivio R01 sotto Motto di Unchio - Bivio R01 a Pian di Les (Giro del Motto di Unchio)
s.da: Verbania Unchio, bivio R01 sotto salita al Motto di Unchio (m 310)
s.nota: An easy path from Verbania Unchio, junction R01 under the mule-track of the ascent to Motto di Unchio, leads to Pian di Les where it meets again R01. Halfway through the recently restored Chapel of the Madonna of Fever.

Verbania Trobaso, Possaccio, terracing west of Bureglio-Vignone, Cà di Müii, crossing of ancient paths, Sentiero delle Coppelle and rock engravings. From Vignone-swimming pool steep path up to Roncaccio (south M.Cimolo), then wide path up to Pian Nava.
La Motta d'Aurelio is an extraordinary balcony on Pianura Padana, Lake Maggiore and Mergozzo, low Ossola. On clear days the view arrives in Milan and the Apennini
Short, almost flat connection from Ungiasca to reach the P02 mule tracks towards the nearby pastures and the long path P00 for Cicogna and Pogallo
Short, almost flat connection from Ungiasca to reach the P02 mule tracks towards the nearby pastures and the long P00 for Cicogna and Pogallo

s.da: bivio A00 in Via XX Settembre
s.a: bivio P01v in Via alla Bergamina
s.nota: Short but steep connection to reach the Sentiero della Bergamina towards Cavandone

s.n: R09 Intragna - Onunchio - Colle della Forcola
s.nota: Intragna and pasture Corpetto, Doaglia, Usciago, Casaiuva, Onunchio, Colle della Forcola. A path in the San Giovanni Valley on practicable and signposted paths up to Onunchio, then less obvious signs with some demanding passages.

s.n: R05b Caprezzo - Alpe Mon Rous (Ôr dal Ruś)
s.a: Alpe Mon Rous (Ôr dal Ruś) bivio R05 (m 862)
s.nota: The route connects Caprezzo at the crossroads of R05 at the Alpe Mon Rous, better known as "Ôr dal Ruś". The part of route around "il Cev" is on asphalted road.

The route connects Aurano passing through its numerous ancient Courts and Pastures (Giovanoli, Segletta connected by a short detour, Caramelli, Laveggio, Calpera) to il Colle, a crossroads of numerous other routes coming from all directions.

A short path from Cappella Porta to the top of the Monti Turrioni from where you can enjoy a wonderful panorama of Lake Maggiore and the surrounding peaks. At the crossroads immediately after the start of the route, take the path that climbs to the right.

From Cambiesso to Cappella Porta passing by Corte Steppio, still loaded with animals in summer and with some well-kept huts, and then by the old pastures of Pechi-Campale, Gajin and Fai. Numerous fords. Some passages exposed but equipped

s.n: R05a Caprezzo - Tremesino - Alpe a Pönt - Bivio R05 sotto Cappella Porta
s.nota: The route starts from the crossroads of R00 in Via dei Ronchi in Caprezzo, climbs to the pasture of Tremesino, reaches the carriage road to the Alpe a Pönt and arrives at the crossroads of R05 just before Cappella Porta.

Interesting summer route on the North side of Monterosso, two coalmen' pitches and the ruins of the Monterosso Farmhouse are visible, the only located on this side of the mountain. Not recommended with rain or frost.

s.n: Raccordo tra P01 e P01b visitando Villa Giuseppina
s.da: bivio P01 presso cancello Villa Giuseppina
s.nota: Connection between two paths that crosses Villa Giuseppina Camelia garden

s.n: P00r - Raccordo pedemontano tra A00 e P00
s.da: A00 presso Chiesa dei Santi Fabiano e Sebastiano
s.a: P00 presso Chiesa di Madonna di Campagna

s.n: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 1 - Verbania Intra - Stresa
s.nota: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

s.n: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 11 - Cannobio - Verbania lntra
s.nota: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.
